title: Speech retry response
description: The outcome recorded once per Idempotency-Key. No queue, provider or quota-account identifiers are exposed; read the investigation for speech and analysis progress.

outcome.description: accepted: missing speech is queued after a fresh quota reservation for the primary or fallback model. quota_exhausted: quota is still exhausted for both models; partial results stay unchanged and no provider call is made. already_complete: speech already succeeded. in_progress: speech is already queued or running. not_eligible: nothing quota-blocked can be retried (no audio, another failure, an uncertain provider outcome on either model, changed provider settings, a missing or changed source or prepared audio, or cancelled or deleted work).
